intent: A clear target-versus-actual chart with animated bars, explicit scale labels and period selection for team goals, service levels and operational metrics.

layout.direction: Three horizontal bullet charts with a thick result bar and a thin target marker. A serif heading balances compact reporting-period controls.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

typography.metadata: 12px monospace for values and scale labels; 14px series/metric labels.
typography.heading: font-display or font-serif, 24-36px, tracking -0.035em

motion.entrance: A single opacity and 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: 150ms press response; 240ms state changes. No ambient loops.
motion.reduced: Stop active figure and entrance animation immediately and set final values on a live reduced-motion change. Finish slope paths or bullet fills without replacing interactive controls or losing keyboard focus.
motion.figures: Endpoint/result figures show actual observations on the first render and interpolate later changes over 280ms. Non-finite values use the documented zero fallback; differences above one trillion settle directly to avoid overflowing animation arithmetic.

responsive.rules: Wrap metric labels, values and long units within a 320px card. Keep actual/target/ceiling labels readable and all period targets at least 44px.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: periods
props.description: Periods containing metrics, targets, ceilings and unit labels. Invalid or negative values become zero.

props.name: defaultPeriod
props.description: Initial period ID, falling back to the first period.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Pass reporting periods in display order with stable unique IDs and their metrics. defaultPeriod selects an initial ID, falling back to the first period.
Every metric has an actual, target, ceiling and unit. Negative or non-finite numbers display as zero; the scale expands to include the result and target.
onPeriodChange reports the chosen ID synchronously. The component keeps local selection, and the host owns persistence and any asynchronous work.
Empty periods and periods without metrics have written empty states. Accessible chart labels include the actual, target, unit and full scale.
